summary: Receives image streams over TCP/IP from a Touch Out TOP in the same or another TouchDesigner process.

key_params.name: address
key_params.note: Computer name or IP address of the Touch Out sender

key_params.name: port
key_params.note: Network port used by the sender

common_gotchas: Windows Firewall can block TouchDesigner TCP/IP streams.
Use matching port/address settings with the Touch Out TOP.
The address can be localhost for same-machine streams.
Queue targets trade latency against smooth playback; too small can stutter, too large adds delay.
When maxqueue overflows, older queued data is removed.
Supports Hap Q, Hap Q Alpha, and uncompressed streams from Touch Out TOP.
key_concepts: Touch In TOP receives image data over TCP/IP from a Touch Out TOP.
Sender and receiver may be in the same TouchDesigner process, on localhost, or on different networked machines.
Queue parameters tune latency and smoothness by controlling target delay and maximum queued stream data.
Touch In TOP supports Uncompressed, Hap Q, and Hap Q Alpha streams produced by Touch Out TOP.
